<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
activation_is_export_safe(name)
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.ops`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/)

Whether a graph built with this activation can be lowered to StableHLO.

## Parameters

- `name` — HF activation name (must be supported — see
  `resolve_activation`).

## Returns

- `bool` — `False` exactly for the erf-based names (`EXPORT_UNSAFE_ACTIVATIONS`), `True` otherwise.

## Raises

- `HFUnsupportedError` — `name` is not a supported activation.
